RoomType.rationale: GlobeHeadNormal.cs:10 `RoomType => RoomType.Monster`. Modeled structurally by pool membership. One shared mechanism across this batch; see `encounter/_room_type_and_weak` in the report.

AllPossibleMonsters.issue: GlobeHeadNormal.cs:12 returns a single-element list with `GlobeHead`. Shared finding, filed once under `encounter/_all_possible_monsters` (see `encounter/aeonglass` for the full enumeration; dormant).

ExtraAssetPaths.rationale: Presentation only -- GlobeHeadNormal.cs:14 declares the `Galvanized` affliction's overlay sprite path so it preloads with the encounter (Globe Head's Galvanic starting power afflicts the player's Power cards with Galvanized). No asset loading or sprite overlays in the headless sim; the AFFLICTION itself (`GalvanicPower`, applied via GenerateMonsters' monster construction) is a `monster`/`power`-tier concern, already ported (`powers.py` GalvanicPower, globe_head.py:33-37) and out of this record's scope.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: ROSTER: GlobeHeadNormal.cs:16-19 returns exactly one `(GlobeHead, null)` pair; `GLOBE_HEAD_NORMAL = Encounter(id="globe_head_normal", monster_classes=[GlobeHead])` (globe_head.py:73-76) -- one monster, same class. ORDER: trivially matches. SLOT: C# passes `null`; the sim's `monster_slots` default `()` leaves `slot_name=None` too -- matches. DRAW COUNT: zero on both sides -- `GlobeHeadNormal.GenerateMonsters` never touches `base.Rng`, and the sim's fixed-composition path draws nothing (monsters/base.py:477-479, `create_monsters`'s own comment).

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: `EncounterModel.ShouldReceiveCombatHooks => false` (EncounterModel.cs:39), not overridden. The sim's `Encounter` dataclass is never registered with `HookSystem` -- never a hook listener on either side.

guards.what: Draw count / stream independence of the per-encounter Rng
The Niche HP-roll (GlobeHead has min_hp==max_hp==148, degenerate range, single enemy)
guards.rationale: Same shape as `encounter/aeonglass`'s check: one draw on both sides (`hashSet={148}` -> `NextItem`; sim `candidates=[148]` -> `next_int_range(0,1)`, combat.py:423-442).

GlobeHeadNormal overrides neither Min/MaxGoldReward (inherits `RoomType.Monster`'s 10-20, matching `GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.MONSTER]`, rewards.py:171) nor ShouldGiveRewards (default `true`/`True` on both sides). `GLOBE_HEAD_NORMAL` passes none of `min_gold`/`max_gold`/`should_give_rewards` (globe_head.py:73-76).
rooms.py:264-268 lists `globe_head` in Glory's `normal_keys`, and `GLOBE_HEAD_NORMAL` is registered in `sts2_rl/monsters/glory/__init__.py`'s `ENCOUNTERS` dict (line 66).
